hints.title: Generate Valid Numbers Level by Level
hints.text: Rather than checking every integer between low and high, generate stepping numbers by appending adjacent digits.

hints.title: Branch on Last Digit
hints.text: From an existing stepping number ending in d, the next candidates are d minus one and d plus one when within 0 to 9.

hints.title: Collect and Sort Matches
hints.text: Start initial states with single digits one through nine, plus zero if low is zero, collecting those within the range.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: S: total count of stepping numbers up to high
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through all integers up to high takes O(high) time, which times out for high = 2 * 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating only stepping numbers bounds the search to a small fraction of integers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle zero as a special starting case and avoid integer overflow.
complexity.notes: The number of stepping numbers up to 2 * 10^9 is small (under 10,000).
